image_description: An interior view of a rustic, older-style sawmill or lumber processing facility. The scene features exposed wooden beams and rafters supporting the roof. In the foreground and mid-ground, there are heavy industrial machines, including what appears to be a bandsaw mill setup with logs positioned on tracks. A person wearing an orange safety vest is visible in the background near machinery. Stacks of processed lumber planks are visible on the right side. The floor is covered in sawdust and wood debris. Large open bays allow natural light to enter from the left.
